description: ATM variant spectrum, VUS burden, carrier frequency, and gnomAD constraint
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

Q = """
query($gene: String!, $ds: DatasetId!) {
  gene(gene_symbol: $gene, reference_genome: GRCh38) {
    gene_id symbol
    gnomad_constraint { pli oe_lof oe_lof_lower oe_lof_upper obs_lof exp_lof oe_mis mis_z }
    variants(dataset: $ds) { variant_id consequence genome { ac an af } exome { ac an af } }
    clinvar_variants { variant_id clinical_significance major_consequence hgvsc hgvsp gold_stars }
  }
}
"""
g = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",
    json={"query":Q,"variables":{"gene":"ATM","ds":"gnomad_r4"}}, timeout=180).json()["data"]["gene"]

cv = pd.DataFrame(g["clinvar_variants"]); gn = pd.DataFrame(g["variants"])
plp = cv[cv["clinical_significance"].isin(
    ["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic","Likely pathogenic, low penetrance"])].copy()
print("ClinVar P/LP ATM variants:", len(plp))

def grp(c):
    c = str(c)
    if "frameshift" in c: return "frameshift"
    if "stop_gained" in c: return "nonsense"
    if "splice_donor" in c or "splice_acceptor" in c: return "canonical splice"
    if "splice" in c: return "other splice"
    if "missense" in c: return "missense"
    if "inframe" in c: return "in-frame indel"
    if "start_lost" in c or "stop_lost" in c: return "start/stop lost"
    if "synonymous" in c: return "synonymous"
    return "other/non-coding"
plp["grp"] = plp["major_consequence"].apply(grp)
spec = plp["grp"].value_counts()
print("\nGrouped P/LP spectrum:\n", spec.to_string())
trunc = spec.reindex(["frameshift","nonsense","canonical splice"]).fillna(0).sum()
print("\nTruncating (fs + nonsense + canonical splice): %d / %d = %.1f%%" % (trunc, len(plp), 100*trunc/len(plp)))
print("Missense among P/LP: %.1f%%" % (100*spec.get("missense",0)/len(plp)))
print("\nGold stars among P/LP:\n", plp["gold_stars"].value_counts().sort_index().to_string())

gn["af_ex"] = gn["exome"].apply(lambda d: (d or {}).get("af") or 0.0)
gn["ac_ex"] = gn["exome"].apply(lambda d: (d or {}).get("ac") or 0)
gn["an_ex"] = gn["exome"].apply(lambda d: (d or {}).get("an") or 0)
m = gn.merge(plp[["variant_id","grp","hgvsc","hgvsp","clinical_significance"]], on="variant_id", how="inner")
tot_af = m["af_ex"].sum()
print("\nP/LP variants seen in gnomAD v4 exomes:", (m['ac_ex']>0).sum(), "of", len(plp))
print("Summed P/LP allele frequency = %.5f  ->  heterozygote carrier frequency ~ 1 in %.0f"
      % (tot_af, 1/(2*tot_af)))
print("Predicted A-T birth incidence (q^2) = 1 in %.0f" % (1/(tot_af**2)))

pd.set_option("display.width",240); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",34)
print("\nTop 12 P/LP ATM alleles by gnomAD v4 exome frequency:\n",
      m.sort_values("af_ex",ascending=False).head(12)[
        ["variant_id","hgvsc","hgvsp","grp","ac_ex","an_ex","af_ex"]].to_string(index=False))

print("\nConstraint:", json.dumps(g["gnomad_constraint"]))

# ---- Figure ----
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,5))
order = spec.sort_values(ascending=True)
ax[0].barh(order.index, order.values, color="#4C78A8")
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(order.items()):
    ax[0].text(v+20, i, f"{v} ({100*v/len(plp):.0f}%)", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("Number of ClinVar variants")
ax[0].set_title("ATM pathogenic / likely pathogenic variant spectrum\n(ClinVar via gnomAD v4, n=%d)" % len(plp))
ax[0].set_xlim(0, order.max()*1.25)

allsig = cv["clinical_significance"].value_counts()
keep = ["Uncertain significance","Likely benign","Pathogenic","Benign/Likely benign",
        "Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Benign"]
vals = allsig.reindex(keep).fillna(0)
cols = ["#B0B0B0","#8CC6A0","#D1434A","#4C9A6A","#F2B100","#D1434A","#E8777C","#2E7D4F"]
ax[1].barh(range(len(vals))[::-1], vals.values, color=cols)
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(vals))[::-1]); ax[1].set_yticklabels(vals.index, fontsize=9)
for i,v in enumerate(vals.values):
    ax[1].text(v+80, len(vals)-1-i, f"{int(v)}", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlabel("Number of ClinVar submissions-level variants")
ax[1].set_title("ATM ClinVar classification distribution (n=%d)\nVUS burden: %.0f%% of all classified variants"
                % (len(cv), 100*allsig.get("Uncertain significance",0)/len(cv)))
ax[1].set_xlim(0, vals.max()*1.25)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
